summary: Q1 (INTRO-V1-GAP1-PRE1-CH1 start, S001-S021). Opening does NOT hook in 3 s: S001 is a puffy white mannequin glove sliding flat into a black void - no glass, no dust film, no wipe band, salt = two round white dots - then 4.5-10 s of a static, defocusing glove before the salt hand appears. Story-critical breaks in PRE1: S016 never reveals the empty bench and S017 puts the restorer's reflection exactly on the empty seat, so the audience reads 'someone is sitting opposite her' - the pre-chorus's whole point (an empty seat, a night of waiting) is lost. Faces still read as mannequins in S007, S010 (frontal/3-4 pink masks, beret + sweater costume), S014 (lit profile) and S020 (black band across the eyes like a blindfold). Match cuts: T03 chart (S004-S005) and the S001-S002 hidden seam work; T07 bowl (S015-S016) lands on position/scale but the plum band is invisible on both sides; T05 needle-to-pupil (S009-S010) fails (no eye); S011-S012 fingertip match is loose; S002-S003 hidden cut pops (lantern jumps 0.07 frame height, sea glitter and reflection brighten); S012-S013 drops 1 stop and flips warm to blue. Director notes status: #1 faces - S010 NOT fixed (S007/S014/S020 same problem); #2 map stripes - S021 NOT fixed; #3 S007 - partially (black passage shortened to ~0.5 s at 42.1-42.6 s but u=0.5 is still near-black, and the sail fills 0.7 s before '帆'); #7 grain - NOT fixed (module-side grain still in ship_cabin, sea_deck, pier_waiting, harbor_eras, map_office); #8 exposure at cuts - OK except S012-S013 and the S002-S003 reflection pop; no unscripted black frames. Keepers: S004/S005 registry, S008 junk on dusk sea, S009 compass, S016 candle/rice grade, S018 city rise, CH1 wide-to-close progression S018-S021. Palette per era is right (navigator lantern-amber/dusk-blue, home candle/cold lattice moon, migrant 2400K, modern neutral-cool); no dawn warmth leaks. Corridor/S062-S066 are outside this section.

findings.issue: The 3-second hook does not read as 'gloved hand wiping museum glass'. f6-f72: a puffy, segmented, mannequin-white glove slides in flat from frame right, fingers horizontal, and rotates upright by 3.0 s in a pure black void. No glass surface is perceptible: no dust film, no lit upper edge, no cleared band, no contact reflection - only two out-of-focus grey vertical bars at x~0.05/0.94 that read as cage bars. The 'salt crystals' at 3.0 s are two round white dots (read as dead pixels/stars). The brass glint at the bottom is the only cue of a vitrine.
findings.fix: Make the glass the subject of the first 3 s: (1) dust film on the pane as a visible haze (sRGB ~35-45 under the 3000K top spot, brightest across the top 30% of frame, fine speckle + 2 faint old fingerprints); the wipe mask must leave a ~14%-frame-high band that drops to the near-black velvet, so the clean stripe is unmistakable by 2.0 s. (2) Fingertip contact: only index+middle pads on the glass, hand ~35 deg off the pane, add the pane's front-surface reflection of the fingertip (mirrored, 15% opacity) meeting the real fingertip at the contact point at (0.78,0.52) on 1.23 s. (3) Keep the hand in the wipe pose for 1.2-4.5 s (arc from (0.80,0.50) to ~(0.45,0.42)); rotate to the upright T01 pose only after 4.5 s. (4) Slim the glove (finger width -20%), cotton-weave normal, warm white #E9E4DA at ~0.55 so the knuckle seams disappear. (5) Salt: 6-8 faceted 2-4 px crystals clustered in the cleared band x 0.55-0.70, each twinkling for 3-5 frames as the spot catches them, starting 2.75 s. (6) Dim the two far hood edges to <=8% or drop them in S001.

findings.issue: The eye CU is a bald, pink, three-quarter mannequin head with sculpted closed lids, a huge ear and a grey cap: the mask is fully exposed and there is no eye, so the emotional beat ('迷茫的眼睛') and the T05 match (needle pivot (0.46,0.50) -> pupil) both fail; the eye region sits at ~(0.53,0.30). No beard/scar/head-cloth; the wind-in-strands action is off (strands.visible=false). Director note #1 not fixed for S010.
findings.fix: Restage as a low-key eye-line CU: camera behind his right shoulder at ~3/4 back, 100 mm, the stern window lattice (frame left) as a dusk-blue backlight so his profile is near-silhouette; only brow ridge, lid line and eye-socket rim take the cool light, lantern warm only on the cheek edge/ear. Put a 3-4 px wet catch-light exactly at (0.46,0.50) - that is the 'pupil' for the T05 match - and play the 51.39 blink as the catch-light vanishing for 4 frames. Indigo head-cloth over a topknot (not a cap), loose strands visible and moving. Skin desaturated weathered brown, not pink.

findings.issue: The restorer's faint reflection lands exactly on the empty bench across from the wife (~(0.62,0.42)), seated, hands resting on the table: it reads as a second person sitting opposite her for the whole shot (f1608-f1692). That destroys PRE1's core image (对面的座位始终空着 / 一夜未眠). The home is also tiny (wife ~20% of frame height), so her breathing at 69.6 s does not read.
findings.fix: Move her reflection off the bench: reflected head+shoulder at ~(0.82,0.30), larger than the home figures (head ~18% of frame height: she is nearer the glass), partly cut by the right muntin, warm 3500K rim distinct from the candle, >=4 px soft once focus goes deep - or put it over the left wall above the wife. Keep the right bench visibly empty with the bowl and chopsticks in the lattice moonlight. Push in (100 mm or dolly ~30%) so the wife is ~35% of frame height and the shoulder rise at 69.6 s reads.

findings.issue: Dead stretch 4.5-10.5 s: the glove stops, the focus racks off it (f200 = 8.3 s: one fully blurred white glove in black, nothing else), and the navigator's hand only becomes visible ~10-11 s. Six seconds of the opening with no new information right as the vocal enters at 6.6 s.
findings.fix: Have the rack 'find' something: the salt hand starts rising from below frame at 6.6 s at ~25% luminance, is clearly readable (palm, salt sparkles) by 8.5 s and stops one finger short at 11.0 s. Limit the rack so her glove never exceeds ~6 px CoC (both hands should be near-sharp at the 13.25 s end frame as written). Give his hand its cool moon edge and 12 riding salt sparkles from 7.5 s, so the change in focus reveals texture.

findings.issue: The reflection does not read as 'a ship lantern rocking on a deep-blue sea' and the outside does not read as 'a quiet modern museum'. f468/f506: a soft yellow rectangle on a bracket floats over a navy blur with a few white glitter blobs at the right; a hot diagonal orange bar crosses lower centre; at 19.5 s the guard's torch is a hard-edged white triangular wedge stabbing up through the compass at (0.60,0.55) - reads as a render glitch; the restorer's reflection is a grey inverted triangle (V collar) at upper right. Beyond the glass the gallery is pure black.
findings.fix: Sea plate (view_shiplamp as composited): a horizon at ~0.45 of the pane height, lantern-lit swell crests under the lantern whose glints swing with it (6-8 s period, +-6 deg), moon glitter kept to the right third; darken the diagonal orange bar to <=30% or remove it. Torch: replace the wedge with a soft, feathered volumetric beam far in the gallery behind the case, sweeping x 0.85->0.15 over ~0.8 s at <=10% luminance, plus a faint moving pool on the far floor. Outside the glass: two cool moonlit floor shafts and the dark silhouettes of G2/G3 at 8-15% luminance so 'glass = sea, outside = museum' reads. Her reflection: head+shoulder silhouette with a cool rim, not a triangle.

findings.issue: The hidden cut pops. S002 last frame: lantern at ~(0.39,0.29), sea glitter faint, her reflection faint. S003 frame 0: lantern at ~(0.42,0.36) (+0.07 frame height), the glitter at x~0.75 jumps to bright white patches, her reflection brightens and her face appears at the top edge. The hood edges match; the reflected content does not.
findings.fix: Change the S003 side: for its first 12 frames drive the nested sea/lantern view and the mirror pass with S002's end camera and gains (glitter x0.4, reflection opacity = S002 end, lantern at (0.39,0.29)), then ease into the 15 deg arc so the sea slides off by angle. Check f506/f507 as a flip pair - nothing in the pane should move more than 1% of frame.

findings.issue: On '失' (66.32 s) the pull-back is meant to reveal the empty bench; it never does - at 66.32 and at the end frame only the candle and the bowl show, the right edge is a dark plank. With S017 broken too, the empty seat is never established in PRE1. The WIFE's hands at the left edge read as a segmented orange-wood artist's manikin hand, and the bangle is cut off.
findings.fix: Extend the rise/pull so the empty bench occupies the right ~22% (x 0.78-1.0), its edge lit by the lattice moonlight, by 66.32; bowl+chopsticks at ~(0.65,0.55) in front of it. Hands: skin material (desaturated #C9A88A), folded right over left, the silver bangle on the LEFT wrist at ~(0.08,0.62) catching the candle - or crop the hands out and let S017 introduce her.

findings.issue: Frame 0 (and 41.78 s): a frontal, evenly warm-lit mannequin face fills the centre, eyes down; the costume reads as a modern French sailor - blue beret and crew-neck sweater - not an indigo head-cloth over a topknot and a cross-collar jacket. Same costume in S010.
findings.fix: Head-cloth: wrapped indigo cloth with the topknot bump at the crown/back; jacket: faded indigo cross-collar (交领). Light: lantern from behind-left as a 3/4 back key so the face is 60-70% in shadow (nose ridge, brow, cheekbone warm), dusk-blue hatch light as a top rim on the head-cloth and shoulders. Open as an MS (40 mm, head ~30% of frame height), camera ~15 deg below eye-line, so the upward look reads as a shape, not a mask.

findings.issue: Note #3 only partially fixed: f1010-f1022 (42.1-42.6 s) is still a near-black frame (a dark beam with a sliver of blue), i.e. u=0.5 is unreadable. Then the sail already fills the frame by 43.2 s and sits static until the cut, so the reveal arrives 0.7 s before '帆' (43.94) and the 'still rising' hand-off to S008 is not felt. The sky is starry saturated royal blue, while S008 is dusk navy with afterglow.
findings.fix: Aim the path at the hatch from 1.6 s so the dusk-blue opening stays in frame and grows from ~15% to 100% of frame by 43.0 s; lantern bounce on the coaming underside so no frame of the passage falls below ~25/255 mean. Re-time so the sail fills on 43.94 and keeps rising after (battens sliding down >=5% of frame/s to the cut). Grade the sky to S008's dusk (#0E1B30->#2E4A6E, no star field).

findings.issue: The patch lock fails: it renders pale neutral grey-white (~#A8ACA8) with white stitching on the OUTSIDE of a wide cuff band - reads as a laundry label, not the wife's pale-blue cloth (#7D9CBB, = her blouse which reads clearly blue in S017). The fold-back gesture is absent (the three frames are identical). The fingertip 'cracks' are black squiggles that read as insects.
findings.fix: Patch #7D9CBB hand-woven texture, pilled/shiny centre, double knot at the upper-right corner. Play the gesture: 52.75-53.0 s the left thumb+index lift the cuff edge 2-3 cm and turn it back to reveal the patch inside, then the index/middle pads settle on it (contact (0.50,0.52), fingers 30 deg from upper right) and hold. Cracks as 1 px low-contrast hairlines; skin desaturated and darker.

findings.issue: The fingertip gesture match is loose and S012's action does not read. S011 ends with small fingertip pads at ~(0.50,0.45-0.55), fingertip ~12% of frame height; S012 opens on a glove ~3x larger whose fingertips are at ~(0.45,0.64), pointing nearly vertical. S012 holds a half-bowl (the boat side), not a rim shard, the second shard is not visible, nothing joins on '碎' (57.2 s), and the sleeve comes out of a black cylinder.
findings.fix: Change the S012 side: frame 0 at the S011 registration (glove index pad at (0.50,0.52), fingers along the same 30 deg diagonal from upper right, fingertip ~12% of frame height), then ease out to the CU. Make the held piece a ~5 cm rim shard pinched between thumb and index; second shard on grey foam at lower left; on 57.2 s the held shard seats into the other (2-frame settle), the crack closing between two plum blossoms. Sleeve with folds; left forearm on the bench edge as written.

findings.issue: A 'same object, push in' cut drops a full stop and flips colour: S012 end mean 91/255 warm 3500K -> S013 frame 0 mean 45/255, blue-grey, with the shard in shadow. Later in S013 a blown specular bloom sits at the upper left like a lens-flare blob.
findings.fix: Start the slider inside the lamp's raking pool: rotate the shard (or move the lamp) so the crack's first 0.5 s is under the 3500K light, warm, with the cool window only as fill on the far side; frame 0 mean within ~0.3 stop of S012's end. Raise specular roughness or the bloom threshold for this shot so the glaze highlight is a highlight, not a flare.

findings.issue: The lab MCU exposes the mannequin: a fully lit pink profile face with a strapped black loupe; her out-of-focus right arm is a grey tube crossing ~70% of the frame to the ledger; the shard in her left glove reads as a black disc, so '翻过残片看圈足 -> 写下日期' does not read.
findings.fix: Camera over her right shoulder, 3/4 back, 50 mm at ~1.1 m: the shard and loupe are the subject, her face in lost profile (cheek/ear edge only). Put the 3500K lamp behind the shard toward camera-right so the porcelain is the brightest thing in frame and the foot ring's 火石红 catches warm; her right forearm rests along the bench below frame and the pencil enters lower right on 62.82. If the current angle is kept: face key to ~25% and lamp as a rim from frame right; pull the right arm back out of frame.

findings.issue: T07 lands on position and scale (rim centre ~(0.50,0.52), diameter ~77-80% of height on both sides) but not on pattern: S015 is shot straight down and the rim is plain white; S016's rim is a bright silver halo ring around the rice. The plum band - the reason for the match ('相同花纹的碗') - is invisible on both sides.
findings.fix: S015 (this module): tilt 15 deg from vertical from the 6 o'clock side as written, so the outer plum band reads along the near lip (~y 0.86-0.90) with the window motif below it. old_home S016 frame 0: the identical tilt so the same band reads at 6 o'clock under the rice, and cut the rim specular/bloom so the cobalt band is visible instead of a steel-like halo.

findings.issue: The chorus's single action (empty bowl set under the eave on '等', 74.18 s) is unreadable at screen size: the crouched woman is ~12% of frame height and the bowl ~2.5% of frame width; the S019->S020 right-hand gesture match therefore has nothing to match. The door jamb glows as an orange neon outline. The sky fills the right half to the sea horizon rather than the top third, and it is brighter than S018's end sky (117 vs 138/255 top-right) with a different cloud pattern, so the sky match from S018 is weak.
findings.fix: Dolly in (or 50 mm) so the woman is ~40-45% of frame height and the bowl >=5% of frame width at ~(0.30,0.78), on the step's outer edge under the drip line, with a moon specular on the glaze; her right hand lifting off the rim on 74.6 reads in the lower-middle region for the S020 hand-off. Door: soft 1850K candle spill on threshold and step, dim the jamb edge. Sky: use S018's shared sky plate B, grade it ~0.3 stop down to S018's end; keep the moon at (0.80,0.14). (Setup is reused in S041.)

findings.issue: Frame 0 shows the frontal mannequin face with a black band across the eyes (the fringe geometry) - it reads as a blindfold; her right hand floats in front of her chest with no visible forearm (a disembodied hand); the rattan case is lectern-sized (~0.8 m wide, standing to her chest) so she looks like she is at a podium, not sitting with a case across her knees.
findings.fix: Remove/reshape the fringe so no dark band crosses the eyes; open with her head bowed ~25 deg so the 2400K top light leaves the face in brow shadow, or crop the frame at the nose from frame 0. Re-pose the right arm: elbow out toward frame right, forearm visible, hand entering from upper right toward (0.40,0.62) as written. Scale the case to ~60x38x22 cm across her lap (lid ~0.55 m above the floor), knees visible under it; keep the folded-letter/front edge line at y 0.66 for T10.

findings.issue: Director note #2 not fixed for S021: the diagonal louvre stripes still dominate the whole frame, the map is unreadable, the ruler is a matte black slab, and the wet ink line is a thin dark hair barely visible above it - so the S020->S021 line match (letter edge -> ink line at y 0.66) does not land and '握在掌间' has no map to hold.
findings.fix: Stripe contrast <=1.6:1 and confine them to the upper-right ~40% (across the sea part of the map); the line zone y 0.55-0.80 lit by the 2200K kerosene lamp only. Ruler: ebony sheen + a brass edge highlight. The ink line on the drawing edge at y 0.66 with a wet specular that travels with the pen; pen hand above the ruler.

findings.issue: On '刻' (36.99 s) the thumb enters from the upper left far out of focus as a smooth pink blob that covers ~40% of the frame at f895 - it reads as a foreign object, not a seaman's thumb wiping salt off the 午 rim.
findings.fix: Bring the thumb in along the rim at the lower left (the 午 mark, where the salt bloom is), in the focal plane, thumb width <=15% of frame height, weathered brown skin (~#8C5E40), a salt crust on the knuckle; it wipes ~2 cm along the rim, leaving brighter brass. The travelling lantern glint stays as is - it works.

findings.issue: The match itself works (T03 registry holds), but the left brass weight reads as an emissive orange tube (a light-box), and the stern-window light is four horizontal blue stripes across the right 40% of the chart - it reads as blinds and pre-empts S021's louvres. The '蓝' corner lift (32.77 s) is barely visible.
findings.fix: Weight as solid dull brass (#8E7348) with one highlight, no emission. The 直棂 stern window as one soft vertical dusk-blue band at x ~0.78-0.95 with thin vertical bar shadows, keeping the islet (0.62,0.40) in the lamp pool. Make the corner lift 4-6 cm and readable at 48 fps.

findings.issue: The needle barely moves: the first and last frames differ by <=2 deg, so '摆动两三次…在“认得南”时稳稳停住' has no visible settle on 49.77.
findings.fix: Start 8 deg clockwise of south, 2.5 damped cycles, dead still from 49.77 at the T05 pivot (0.46,0.50).

findings.issue: Frame 0: the anchor (her lit window at (0.42,0.46), carried over from S017's candle) competes with ~20 equally bright windows in the right half and the moon glitter on the water; the restorer silhouette in the window is not visible. The city windows are uniform in colour and brightness (game-like grid).
findings.fix: For the first 1.0 s dim the right-half city by ~40% (or start closer so her window is ~25% of frame height) and add the tiny bent silhouette against her lamp; vary window colour 2400-3500K and brightness, <=35% lit. Keep the rise and the moon end frame - they work.

findings.issue: The cumulus bases sit right on the horizon line as hard-edged grey-brown lumps; they read as rock islands floating on the sea.
findings.fix: Lift the cloud bases to y ~0.28-0.32 (horizon at 0.42), feather their undersides, add a thin stratus band with the last warm underlight; keep the coast light at the left and the junk as is.

findings.issue: Director note #7 not done: these modules still draw their own grain (grainQuad/grainMat, half-res or full-screen, with post grain forced to 0) instead of the fixed engine grain. Result: grain texture changes from module to module (coarse in S008, almost clean in S018's sky), visible e.g. at the S018->S019 sky-to-sky match cut.
findings.fix: Delete the module-side grain quads/probes and their GRAIN constants, return per-era 'grain' amounts through post only (engine integer-hash grain), re-check S005/S008/S018/S020/S021 at 1:1.
